rationale: The candidate reads as a single coherent low mass with decent repair integrity, but it is essentially a closed compact box with only mild faceting and no visible public void, entry seam, or terrace response to the access edge. In the four views it remains legible, yet the same object is doing nearly all the work and the road frontage is not meaningfully addressed. For the neighborhood-living brief, this is not enough: the visible mass lacks an active ground threshold and the section does not suggest the public/private hierarchy the program requires. The form also drifts toward generic introverted massing rather than a compact street building with a clear public edge and one usable open-space figure.
